transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... hi. I guess... I'm here because I've been doing some things at work that don't really make sense. 

I do bookkeeping, and... I don't know, lately I've just started doing weird stuff. Like taking the receipts and just lining them all across the floor. Or I'll sit there and tap the calculator in sets of nine. Sometimes I just... I'll just stand by the copier with my hands held up in the air. Just waiting until someone asks if I'm okay. 

I'm not really sure why I do it. But... yeah. That's why I came in.

When you do these things, like lining up the receipts or tapping the calculator, do you feel like you have to do them to prevent something bad from happening, or do you feel like you are doing them for another reason?
I don't know. I just... do them. I don't really think about anything bad happening. It's just... I don't know why.
Do you ever hear voices or sounds that other people around you cannot hear?

Um... yeah. Sometimes, I guess. 

Like if I'm just alone at my desk, or... walking home from class. I'll hear a man's voice. He just says things like, check line seven, or... you missed the sign. It sounds clear enough that I always look around, but... there's never anyone there.
Have you ever had any seizures, or have you noticed any significant changes in your physical health or memory lately?
Um... no. No seizures. And I haven't really noticed anything else with my health or... or my memory. It's just the other stuff.
Have you ever experienced periods where your mood was extremely high or low, lasting for several days or weeks, alongside these other experiences?

Um... yeah, I guess. 

There were a few weeks where I... I was barely sleeping. I just felt really driven to start all these plans. And... yeah, the other stuff was happening then, too. I was hearing the voice. And... I don't know, I just felt sure that the invoice numbers at work were sending me messages. So... yeah.
During the times when you were not feeling that high, driven mood, did you still experience the voices and the urges to perform those strange actions at work?

Um... yeah. 

There was a time... maybe a few weeks, where I was sleeping okay. I didn't feel... hyper, or anything. But... the voice was still there. And I still felt like... like I needed to figure out the patterns in the numbers.
Have you ever experienced periods where you felt persistently sad, hopeless, or lost interest in almost all activities for at least two weeks?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. I haven't really felt... sad like that. Just... just what I already told you.
